title: fix(ui): share theme state and honor control props
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The @pollinations/ui 0.1.0-alpha.15 build shares ESM chunks between the root and subpath imports, preventing theme resets during sign-in transitions in KPI, Observability, and Economics. Disabled IconButton links no longer navigate or respond to clicks, and ConfirmationDialog now blocks dismissal when cancelDisabled is set. The package no longer ships CommonJS exports; the script-tag IIFE remains, while Markdown is available through the ESM @pollinations/ui/markdown subpath rather than the browser bundle. Built-package import tests were added to CI.
